summary: The refreshed GUI, background-sharing fix and native pointer-hiding check are verified. Final installer/release work is in progress. Your final two-PC acceptance checks remain below.

items.title: Website and Windows app source saved in GitHub
items.evidence: Both are in Satish01-oss/Drive-Bridge, with build and release instructions.

items.title: Six-character secure pairing on Wi-Fi and Ethernet
items.evidence: Implemented and covered by secure loopback tests. The earlier v0.7 pair was reported working on Wi-Fi plus Ethernet.

items.title: Keyboard, mouse, headphones and microphone sharing implemented
items.evidence: All four were reported working with v0.7. The new installer version still needs your final hands-on retest below.

items.title: Sharing runs independently of the visible window
items.evidence: Authenticated input/audio delivery passes while either role is minimized/closed to tray and its UI thread is deliberately blocked.

items.title: Minimize and X keep the session in the tray
items.evidence: Automated lifecycle checks pass for hide, restore and explicit quit. Final two-PC acceptance remains below.

items.title: Show the shared pointer on the active PC and restore it safely
items.evidence: Implemented handoff masking and restoration. The native Windows two-second hiding/restore check passed, with cleanup/cancellation regression coverage. Final cross-PC check remains below.

items.title: Refresh the app GUI and check both role screens
items.evidence: Refreshed welcome and side-by-side role layouts. Both role screens were inspected; a regression check confirms normal and smaller sizes have no horizontal scrolling.

items.title: One installer includes the app, runtime and microphone driver
items.evidence: DeviceBridge-Setup-0.8.0.exe compiles. The microphone driver remains an explicit setup with Windows approval/restart.

items.title: Test installation, reinstallation and uninstallation
items.evidence: The final GitHub Windows runner passed installation, reinstall, app-hash, desktop/Start menu shortcut, Installed Apps and uninstall tests.

items.title: Install the finished app on this PC and add its desktop shortcut
items.evidence: The older copy has been exited normally. Installation will follow the GUI refresh.

items.title: Pass app regression checks on the final build
items.evidence: 78 app regression checks passed locally and the final GitHub Windows build/test workflow succeeded. Physical hardware tests remain below.

items.title: Automatically update the website from GitHub Releases
items.evidence: Implemented with versioned downloads, size/SHA-256 validation and failure protection. Installer support passes six release-sync tests.

items.title: Publish the new installer release on GitHub
items.evidence: Waiting for final GUI and installer validation.

items.title: Verify the website shows the new version and downloads the installer
items.evidence: Will be checked after the release deployment.

items.title: Install the same new version on the other PC
items.evidence: Quit the old app from its tray, run the new installer, and open DeviceBridge from the desktop on both PCs.

items.title: Connect the Wi-Fi PC and Ethernet PC with a fresh key
items.evidence: Use the same trusted router. Both app windows must show Connected.

items.title: Type with the shared keyboard
items.evidence: Type a short harmless sentence in Notepad on the other PC. Confirm key releases and shortcuts behave correctly.

items.title: Move, click, drag, scroll and cross the chosen screen edge
items.evidence: Choose Left/Right/Above/Below. Check movement to the other PC and back without a switch button.

items.title: Hear the other PC through this PC's headphones
items.evidence: Play audio on the other PC and confirm it arrives clearly through your headphones.

items.title: Use the shared microphone in the other PC's calling app
items.evidence: Confirm the incoming microphone meter moves. Select CABLE Output in the calling app and run its microphone test.

items.title: See the shared pointer only on the PC being controlled
items.evidence: Move across the screen edge and back. Confirm the inactive pointer hides, the other PC’s own physical mouse reveals its pointer, and disconnect/emergency stop restores pointers.

items.title: Keep all sharing working after minimize and X on both PCs
items.evidence: Continue typing and playing audio after hiding each app. Restore from the tray or desktop shortcut and confirm the session remains Connected.

items.title: Run for two minutes, reconnect and test explicit disconnect
items.evidence: Check there are no stuck keys or unexpected drops, saved reconnect works, and Disconnect/Disconnect and quit stop sharing.

items.title: Add verified Windows publisher signing
items.evidence: Deferred by your earlier choice. A verified signing account/certificate is still needed; unsigned installer warnings may remain.
